Kimchi.note: Fish sauce; salted shrimp. Not vegetarian. Spicy.

Temple Kimchi.note: Made without fish sauce or shrimp. Spicy.

Japchae.note: Beef; soy sauce = soy + wheat; sesame oil; egg strips. Sweet potato noodles themselves have no gluten.

Vegetable Japchae.note: Tamari stated as gluten-free soy sauce, so soy but no gluten; sesame oil; no egg. Vegan.

Haemul Pajeon.note: Squid and mussels = molluscs; prawns; wheat flour; egg; soy dipping sauce (soy sauce assumed wheat-brewed, labelled soy; gluten already present).

Mandu.note: Wheat wrappers; tofu = soy; soy vinegar dip. Pork = not halal.

Gyeran Jjim.note: Egg; anchovy stock = fish, so not vegetarian.

Tteokbokki.note: Gochujang with wheat and soybeans; fish cakes = fish (Korean fish cakes also usually contain wheat). Rice cakes alone are gluten-free but the sauce is not. Spicy.

Rose Tteokbokki.note: Cream and mozzarella = milk; gochujang = wheat + soy; bacon = pork, not halal. Mild.

Corn Cheese.note: Mozzarella and butter = milk; mayonnaise = egg.

Samgyeopsal.note: Pork belly = not halal; ssamjang = soybean + wheat; sesame oil. Mild.

Beef Bulgogi.note: Soy sauce = soy + wheat; sesame oil. Halal by ingredients (beef, no alcohol stated).

Spicy Pork Bulgogi.note: Gochujang and soy sauce = soy + wheat; sesame oil; pork. Spicy.

LA Galbi.note: Soy sauce; sesame oil; mirin = rice wine with alcohol, so not halal. Mirin is not counted as sulphites or gluten (rice and rice koji; v3 rule).

Dak Galbi.note: Gochujang = wheat + soy. Perilla leaves (sometimes called 'sesame leaves') are not sesame. Very spicy.

Grilled King Oyster Mushrooms.note: King oyster is a mushroom, not a mollusc. Sesame oil.

Grilled Tofu Steak.note: Tofu and soy sauce glaze = soy + wheat; sesame seeds.

Kimchi Jjigae.note: Kimchi with fish sauce and salted shrimp; anchovy stock; tofu; pork belly = not halal. Spicy.

Sundubu Jjigae.note: Tofu; clams; prawns; egg; anchovy broth. Very spicy.

Doenjang Jjigae.note: Doenjang stated to contain wheat; tofu. Kelp broth, no meat. Mild.

Samgyetang.note: Chicken, glutinous rice (no gluten), ginseng, jujube, garlic. No listed allergens.

Dolsot Bibimbap.note: Gochujang = wheat + soy; marinated beef; fried egg; sesame oil. Mild.

Vegetable Bibimbap.note: Gochujang = wheat + soy; tofu; sesame oil. No egg. Mild.

Naengmyeon.note: Wheat in the noodles (buckwheat itself is not gluten, but the wheat is); egg; mustard. Not spicy.

Injeolmi Bingsu.note: Milk ice and condensed milk; roasted soybean powder; almond flakes. Glutinous rice cake, no gluten. No peanuts.
